english:
Submachine Guns behave like Lightweight Frame SMGs and grant Lightweight Frame-intrinsic benefits: 2 Mobility tiers and 6.25% increased Forward Movement Speed.

Shotguns behave like Precision Frame Shotguns and grant no intrinsic benefits.

Equipping <yellow MIDA Multi-Tool /> increases the Forward Movement Speed bonus to 10% for both weapon archetypes.

source.text:
SMG: Behaves like a Lightweight SMG | Shotgun: Behaves like a Precision Shotgun
Forward Movement Speed Bonus is increased to 10% while MIDA Multi-Tool is equipped.
